name: Drupal RAG
description: Converts Drupal content types and media types into a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using pgvector and Ollama.
project_description: Drupal RAG turns a Drupal 11 site into a self-hosted Retrieval-Augmented Generation system. Entity CRUD events queue selected content and media types, a queue worker extracts their plain text (files such as PDF/DOCX/TXT are parsed; everything else is rendered through a view mode and stripped of HTML), the text is split into overlapping sentence-aware chunks, each chunk is embedded via a local Ollama server and stored as a native pgvector column (HNSW-indexed) in a dedicated PostgreSQL connection. Three POST endpoints then serve cosine-similarity retrieval (/api/rag/query), an assembled prompt for any LLM (/api/rag/prompt) and a full generated answer via Ollama chat (/api/rag/augment). Embeddings and generation run against your own Ollama instance and your own database, so content is not sent to third-party AI vendors. Note: pgvector and Ollama are external infrastructure, not Drupal module dependencies. This documented release is a pre-release alpha (1.0.0-alpha5), not covered by Drupal's security advisory policy.
